summary: Camden County, MO towersite acquired 1945-46; 60-ft pole tower 1946, steel tower FY 1955-56; 2018 plan covers fire-tower records and radio-tower upkeep; no source confirms status today.

facts.status_note: No source describes the tower as it stands today. A 2018 plan calls for annual maintenance of the radio towers at Branch and Camdenton (not the fire tower), and a 2021 MDC map lists a Fire Tower in its legend.

corrections.why: The 60-foot figure belongs to the June 1946 pole structure. The 1955-56 steel replacement has no height in the source, so the record's height describes the earlier tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 40 acres in the 1945-46 annual report and the 1947-48 manual; 39 acres on the MDC map last updated 5/10/2021. The story gives both figures and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Build history comes from the Central US Lookouts page (quoting annual reports and newspapers), with the 2018 plan and 2021 map for later status. Nothing read confirms the tower stands now or whether it can be visited. Verification: the 2018 plan's maintenance clause reads 'Provide annual maintenance to both Branch and Camdenton CSC area radio towers', so it covers radio towers, not the fire tower; the earlier 'one other site' reading was wrong and the story's inference from it was removed. Plan date 2018 is confirmed by its FY 2018-2032 title. A separate Camdenton Conservation Service Center tower is not covered. No photos found. Fetch budget overrun by a few reads.
